'''Xomit Grunseit''' was a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the leader of a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] faction based on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] during [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
At some stage prior or during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Grunseit acquired a facility on the volcanic [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. He would base his operations there, along with four other leaders of the faction. He would assemble a large force of soldiers loyal to him, including his [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]] [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]].<ref name="Eminence" />

Grunseit would be in his [[Black Sun fortress/Legends|facility]] when Moj introduced [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and the two [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] to him. Maul stated to him that he was forming an [[Shadow Collective/Legends|army]] and that he wished for Grunseit and his faction to join him. Grunseit mocked Maul and his allies and refused to ally with the Sith Lord.<ref name="Eminence" />

Grunseit ordered his guards to kill Maul, Vizsla and the others but Opress managed to kill one of the guards and throw the corpse on the table. Maul asked one final time and the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] stood up stating that they were the Black Sun. Opress then ignited his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and hurled it at Grunseit and the other Falleens. Grunseit watched as the lightsaber decapitated his advisors seconds before he was beheaded.<ref name="Eminence" />

===Legacy===
Grunseit's faction would continue to survive after his death, but they would ultimately be absorbed into Maul's new Shadow Collective.<ref name="Eminence" /> Those soldiers would prove instrumental, as would Ziton Moj, in the [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|takeover]] and [[Battle_of_Mandalore/Legends|battle]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]; the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]—sometime after Grunseit's death.<ref name="Shades of Reason">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Xomit Grunseit was voiced by [[Kevin Michael Richardson]] in "[[Eminence (episode)|Eminence]]," the fourteenth episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]]. In credits, the character was listed as the Black Sun Leader #1. The actor also voiced [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]] in the episode.<ref name="Eminence" />
